'''Jenarian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Order of Revan]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] he was defending a Revanite position at the [[Imperial Guard Academy]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where he was killed by combined forces of the [[Yavin Coalition]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Jenarian appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]]. Killing him is required to obtain an achievement.
